An ORBIT artifact-completion fixture proves unverified output is rejected while a verified output_path and positive output_bytes satisfy generic filename and Desktop evidence. No task identity, fixed target provider, requested highlight term, answer text, or target filename appears in runtime code or schemas.
implementation_evidence.model_choice_contract: The model still selects the action and supplies source_path, output_path, provider_name, optional response_field, matching behavior, paragraph separation, highlight terms, overwrite, and opening behavior. Lexical copying is the explicit action semantic rather than a hidden argument rewrite; a future decoded operation requires a separately named contract.
